bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,os,sys
def sh(a):
 p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=22)
 if p.returncode:sys.exit(61)
 return p.stdout.strip()
name='deploy-gaybbs-1'
label=sh(['docker','inspect',name,'--format','{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}'])
file=label.split(',')[0].strip()
conf=json.loads(sh(['docker','compose','-f',file,'-p','deploy','config','--format','json']))
secrets=conf.get('secrets',{})
keys=['bot_token','db_password','tumblr_bridge_key']
mask=0
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
 ref=secrets.get(k,{})
 f=ref.get('file')
 if not f or not os.path.isfile(f):mask|=1<<i
service=conf['services']['gaybbs']
vols=service.get('volumes',[])
if any(isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('type')=='bind' and not os.path.exists(v.get('source','')) for v in vols):mask|=8
container=json.loads(sh(['docker','inspect',name]))[0]
if any(m['Type']=='bind' and not os.path.exists(m['Source']) for m in container.get('Mounts',[])):mask|=16
sys.exit(100+mask)
PY
